goal: AI-powered sector rotation analytics web app using Claude agents to analyze macroeconomic conditions, score market sectors, generate portfolio allocations, and deliver visual dashboards with RRG charts.
guards: Do not delete or overwrite existing tests
Do not modify files outside the declared scope
Do not introduce secrets or credentials into the repository
Do not pass current dates to agent prompts (anti-look-ahead-bias rule)
Do not switch agents back to claude-opus-4-6 — use claude-sonnet-4-6
